value.rationale: Multi-attribute paired-comparison graphs naturally have clique-product structure. This theorem determines the exact worst-case coordinatewise sensitivity of an energy-normalized Hodge least-squares projection, shows pairwise-only contributions for any number of factors, identifies unique globally worst conductance ratios and vulnerable coordinate directions, and gives a linear-dimensional hypercube growth law. These are meaningful global design/classification facts, not a finite-table recomputation or renaming of the already known two-factor special case.
